en.headline: Grammy-winning jazz vocalist Nicole Zuraitis returns to Xiqu Centre tonight
en.dek: The New York-based singer and her quartet perform two sets each evening on 24 and 25 August at the Tea House Theatre in West Kowloon.
body: Two-time Grammy Award-winning jazz vocalist and pianist Nicole Zuraitis returns to Hong Kong for four performances at the Tea House Theatre of the Xiqu Centre on Monday and Tuesday.

The Nicole Zuraitis Quartet appears at 7 pm and 9 pm on both 24 and 25 August. Each set lasts about 75 minutes without interval. The band features Zuraitis on vocals and piano, Dan Pugach on drums, Idan Morim on guitar and Sam Weber on bass. Tickets are priced at HK$520 and include one complimentary drink. The 7 pm and 9 pm programmes feature different sets.

The concerts form part of Premiere Performances Jazz’s 20th season. Zuraitis previously sold out shows in Hong Kong in 2025. The Tea House Theatre is located at the Xiqu Centre in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 葛萊美得主Nicole Zuraitis今晚起戲曲中心茶館劇場演出
zh.dek: 紐約爵士歌手連同四重奏於8月24及25日每晚兩場在西九戲曲中心茶館劇場登台。
body: 兩度葛萊美獎得主爵士歌手兼鋼琴家Nicole Zuraitis重返香港，周一及周二於西九文化區戲曲中心茶館劇場演出四場。
Nicole Zuraitis四重奏於8月24日及25日晚上7時及9時各演一場，每場約75分鐘，不設中場休息。樂隊成員包括主唱及鋼琴Nicole Zuraitis、鼓手Dan Pugach、結他手Idan Morim及低音大提琴手Sam Weber。門票售價520港元，包括一杯飲品。兩場節目曲目不同。
演出屬飛躍演奏爵士系列20周年樂季節目。Zuraitis去年在港演出全場爆滿。茶館劇場位於西九文化區戲曲中心。
